title: Smartwatches are struggling to connect with Strava
summary: A smartwatch-to-Strava glitch is frustrating the fitness community.
body: Credit: Kaitlyn Cimino / Android Authority TL;DR Strava is reportedly having trouble syncing with smartwatches. Users are experiencing the issue on Galaxy, Garmin, and Apple devices. It’s unclear what the cause of the issue is. After a run, swim, ride, and so on, you shouldn’t have to even think about sending over your workout data from your smartwatch to Strava . Syncing your device with the app automatically uploads this recorded information to your profile. However, a new pesky bug appears to be getting in the way. We’re seeing multiple reports on Reddit about an issue with Strava. According to the affected users, they are being greeted by an error message when attempting to connect their smartwatch to the app. The syncing issue reportedly persists whether you’re using the Samsung Health app or Health Connect.
